patch.value: Explain learned policy suitability with portable replayable cards

Export minimized policy suitability, scope, action limits, regressions and evidence digests across agent backends; automatically retain explanations throughout recursive candidate and promotion paths.

Missing provenance blocks adoption; replay identifies every cited result; export contains no training examples or credentials; typed SDK and compact TOON/JSON CLI; every recursive candidate and promotion has a card; read-only public tracker validation demonstrates at least two generations; npm and Bun CI release gates pass at unchanged thresholds.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap check: current host CLI is 2026.10.23; package SDK remains pinned at 2026.10.20. Inspected CLI command ownership and pm-context context-pack explanations: neither exports learned-policy suitability. Existing pm-rl checkpoint artifacts retain executable state; generation provenance, causal plans, shadow comparisons and recursive improver receipts own the evidence. Cards will reuse SDK complete inventory, certified history reads and content-addressed package hashes. No dependency bump, trainer replacement or context assembler. Plan: minimized digest-only cards, replay/adoption refusals, automatic recursive candidate/outcome publication, non-Git public-copy validation for two generations, targeted local checks and full npm/Bun CI gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented typed export/replay/adoption-check SDK and CLI, bounded digest-only projection, exact timestamped history citations and retained candidate/promotion cards. Recursive durable phases now retain outcome cards plus one card per proposed configuration/recipe. Local typecheck, lint, duplication and docstring checks passed before the last small additions; targeted regression work is ongoing. Verified the selected pm-ops commit is publicly accessible and MIT licensed; prepared a read-only non-Git copy for two-generation numerical-policy acceptance. Full release gates will run in CI because the shared host is saturated.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proof: disabled only recordRecursivePolicyCards publication; the durable recursive-phase regression failed with 0 retained cards versus 6 required. Restored implementation; targeted suite passed 8/8 with no skips, new module 100% lines/functions and 98.35% branches before final branch cases. The first real-data run passed two promotions, 5 retained cards, 19 replayed citations, 105 training plus 41 held-out items and unchanged 300-file source digest. Compact output measured 2082-2085 JSON bytes and 1544-1547 TOON bytes. Final packed rerun and CI gates pending.

value.text: PR: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rl/pull/100 (ready for review). value.author: codex-agent
value.text: CI caught a feature integration error, not a pm SDK defect: adding explanatory fields inside replay-critical trainer configurations caused resume/status comparisons to fail. Moving that metadata to native SDK notes preserves the original training receipts and their exact replay contract. Creation-history coordinates also keep seed cards stable across claims/comments so failed resumes do not add card artifacts. Completing peer-edit fixture provenance while retaining its concurrency/rollback assertions. The new card module itself measured 100% lines/branches/functions in the failed full-gate run; complete gates will be rerun after regression fixes.

Native evaluation notes preserve the exact original trainer configuration. Typecheck, test typecheck, lint, duplication, docstrings and changelog checks remain required; full npm/Bun CI will be rerun at unchanged thresholds.

value.text: Auditing one final publication boundary: after promotion commits, an IO failure can prevent its outcome card from being written. Resume must publish that missing card from verified committed evidence before advancing. Adding a real filesystem obstruction test around the real SDK close, with no fabricated SDK results, and recovery in the verified complete/refused generation branches.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Strengthened the evidence domain to include collection-policy, environment, checkpoint and parent metadata, in addition to body/type/version/status and evaluation notes. The targeted regression changes a real collection Run policy field and requires the old card to refuse adoption.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final-head CI exposed one valid legacy-reference compatibility case: a Generation approval stored in uppercase resolves through the SDK but the card identifier guard rejected it before lookup. Allowing ASCII case in input validation delegates resolution to the SDK; exported evidence still uses the canonical SDK item id. Reusing the existing mixed-approval-alias resume regression and adding an uppercase export equivalence assertion. Bun completed 755 tests with this single failure; targeted verification and final gates are being rerun.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Alias compatibility verification: node --test --test-name-pattern="mixed approval aliases" test/meta.test.ts passed 1/1, zero fail/skip. The minimized-card canonical/uppercase export regression passed 1/1. Reverting only the case-insensitive identifier guard made that regression fail with card_invalid; restored the guard. npm run typecheck, npm run build:test, npm run lint, npm run docstring and git diff --check passed. The previous full CI matrix completed 755 tests per job with 754 passing and this single alias failure. Final release gates will rerun on the corrected source at unchanged thresholds.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review blocked three acceptance properties: adoption must certify retained cards and evidence through the full root ancestry; policy identity must bind the checkpoint artifact plus configuration instead of evaluation-only metadata; operational read faults must remain retryable rather than terminal promotion refusals. Branch pulled and main checked: no new main commits to merge. Reusing this item. Each fix will receive a real-tracker regression and isolated behavioral revert proof, then targeted checks and exact-head npm/Bun CI.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review fixes implemented: adoption certifies retained current cards and all cited evidence through the canonical root ancestry; missing roots, cards, root-only evidence and cycles fail closed. Policy identity now binds content-addressed checkpoint/policy references plus configuration; evaluation notes do not redefine a policy. Unfitted proposals expose proposal_digest with a null policy_digest and cannot be adopted. Native operational read faults use provenance_read_retryable, and only explicit policy/permission verdict codes are terminal promotion refusals. Initial three review regressions passed; dedicated suite passed 14/14 before expanded ancestry edge cases. Typecheck, test typecheck, lint, duplication and docstring gates passed. Isolated revert proofs and updated public-copy evidence are underway.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Isolated behavioral revert proofs completed, one fix at a time with all other fixes retained. Removing only the adoption ancestry verification made "adoption requires every ancestor generation, retained card and cited result through the root" fail: missing expected rejection after deleting the grandparent. Restoring configuration-only policy hashing made "policy identity binds checkpoint content and configuration independently of evaluation notes" fail on equal digests for distinct checkpoints. Restoring only the old snapshot catch made "operational card reads are typed retryable errors and promotion remains resumable" fail with missing expected rejection: the one-shot EIO was converted into a terminal promotion refusal. Each reverted run exited 1; all fixes were restored exactly. The complete dedicated suite passed 14/14 with no skips before the final stricter SDK read classifier and opaque-reference case; the restored three regressions are being rerun. Public-copy validation passed two promoted/resumed generations, five retained cards and 19 citations, with all 300 source files unchanged; final JSON measures 2173-2176 bytes and TOON 1630-1633 bytes.
